## Walkthrough This PR adds integration tests for oc-mirror's parallel copy feature, a multilayer test image and build tooling, YAML test inputs for image- and layer-parallel scenarios, and a small change to retry logic treating HTTP 500–504 as retryable. ## Changes **Parallel copy integration tests** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |---|---| |**Multilayers test image and build infrastructure**
`tests/integration/image-builders/additional_images/README.md`, `tests/integration/image-builders/additional_images/multilayers/Dockerfile`, `tests/integration/image-builders/additional_images/multilayers/Makefile`, `tests/integration/image-builders/additional_images/multilayers/README.md`|A new multilayer OCI image definition with ten sequential `RUN` steps, a parameterized Makefile for build/push, and docs describing the image used for `--parallel-layers` testing.| |**ImageSetConfiguration test data**
`tests/integration/testdata/imagesetconfigs/parallel_copy/isc-multilayers.yaml`, `tests/integration/testdata/imagesetconfigs/parallel_copy/isc-parallel-images.yaml`|Two YAML fixtures: one references the multilayers image for layer-parallel tests; the other supplies ten additional image tags to exercise image-parallel behavior.| |**Parallel copy test suite and validation helpers**
`tests/integration/parallel_copy_test.go`|Ginkgo suite that runs mirror operations with configured `--parallel-layers` and `--parallel-images`, plus helpers (`mirrorCopyOutput`, `imagesToCopyCount`, and `expectMinImagesToCopy`) to parse oc-mirror output and assert expected queued-image counts.| **Mirror retry policy** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |---|---| |**HTTP server-error retry range update**
`internal/pkg/mirror/mirror.go`|`isErrorRetryable` now treats HTTP 500–504 responses as retryable (previously 502–504).| 🎯 3 (Moderate) | ⏱️ ~20 minutes

Thanks for the PR. I added few comments.

Needs to check why the integration test is failing, is it because of some kind of race condition when images share the same blob on few layers?

🧹 Nitpick comments (1)
internal/pkg/mirror/mirror.go (1)
`240-242`: _⚡ Quick win_ **Consider excluding HTTP 501 from the retry range.** The current condition retries all HTTP status codes 500–504. However, HTTP 501 (Not Implemented) is not a transient error and should not be retried—if a server lacks the functionality, repeated attempts will continue to fail. Consider explicitly excluding 501 to avoid unnecessary retry attempts.
♻️ Proposed fix to exclude HTTP 501 ```diff case errors.As(err, &httpError): - // Retry on 500-504 server errors, they appear to be quite common in the field + // Retry on transient 5xx server errors (500, 502-504), they appear to be quite common in the field // We duplicate this here because older versions of oc-mirror cannot bump containers/common given Golang version restrictions - if httpError.StatusCode >= http.StatusInternalServerError && httpError.StatusCode <= http.StatusGatewayTimeout { + if (httpError.StatusCode >= http.StatusInternalServerError && httpError.StatusCode <= http.StatusGatewayTimeout) && httpError.StatusCode != http.StatusNotImplemented { return true } ```
🤖 Prompt for AI Agents ``` Verify each finding against current code. Fix only still-valid issues, skip the rest with a brief reason, keep changes minimal, and validate.
